scenarios.name: colorless-eldrazi-spell-costs-two-less
scenarios.why: Eldrazi Devastator is a colorless Eldrazi spell cast by Eye's controller; its eight generic mana cost falls to six, which exactly six colorless mana pays.

scenarios.name: colored-spell-does-not-receive-colorless-eldrazi-reduction
scenarios.why: Grizzly Bears is green rather than a colorless Eldrazi spell, so the Eye's reduction does not apply and green alone cannot pay its generic component.
